objects.name: FastNetMon eliminates third-party bgp lookups with Netomics
objects.description: FastNetMon is introducing Netomics, a self-hosted BGP routing intelligence platform that combines live routing data, registry information, RPKI validation, routing history and AI-assisted querying into a single application.
